promises.quote: The salient proposais in the Hartley Bends locality were as follows:
promises.summary: Install interactive vehicle activated signs, high friction surface material, and additional hatching to improve road safety

concerns.quote: The speed limit in the section of the A46 known as the 'Hartley Bends' should be reviewed and reduced so as to improve the safety of drivers as they approach these bends.
The road signs including carriageway markings should be reviewed and improved so as to provide greater warning to drivers as to the severity of the approaching bends.
Consideration be given to the provision of 'rumble strips' in advance of the bends so as to further encourage the reduction in the speed of vehicles as they approach the bends.
there have been a number of road traffic collisions at this junction involving drivers emerging on to the A36
The speed limit in the section of the A36 either side of Branch Road should be reduced so as to improve the safety of drivers both those on A36 and those emerging from Branch Road
concerns.hazard: speed limit too high on A36 near Branch Road

concerns.quote: The road signs including carriageway markings should be reviewed and improved so as to provide greater warning to drivers as to the risk from this junction
Whilst not factors in this collision appropriate repairs should be made to the high friction surface and road markings in the vicinity of the junction
concerns.hazard: worn road surface and markings at junction

links.explanation: Both reports call for reviewing and improving road signs and carriageway markings to give drivers better warning. They differ in that the earlier focuses on bend severity while the later focuses on junction risk.
links.earlier_quote: The road signs including carriageway markings should be reviewed and improved so as to provide greater warning to drivers as to the severity of the approaching bends.
links.later_quote: The road signs including carriageway markings should be reviewed and improved so as to provide greater warning to drivers as to the risk from this junction.
